mapper.select: select count(*) from project where deleted = 0
select count(*) from server where deleted = 0
select count(*) from app where deleted = 0
select count(*) from app_instance where deleted = 0 and status = 'ONLINE'
select count(*) from deploy where deleted = 0
select count(*) from deploy where deleted = 0 and status = 'PENDING'
select count(*) from alarm where deleted = 0 and status = 'UNHANDLED'

select date_format(apply_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as `date`, count(*) as `count` from deploy where deleted = 0 and apply_time is not null and apply_time >= #{startDate} group by date_format(apply_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by `date`
select al.`level` as `level`, count(*) as `count` from alarm al where al.deleted = 0 group by al.`level`
select env as `env`, count(*) as `count` from server where deleted = 0 group by env
select status as `status`, count(*) as `count` from deploy where deleted = 0 group by status
select status as `status`, count(*) as `count` from alarm where deleted = 0 group by status

select a.id as `id`, a.name as `name`, (select count(*) from deploy d where d.app_id = a.id and d.deleted = 0) as `deployCount`, (select count(*) from alarm al where al.app_id = a.id and al.deleted = 0) as `alarmCount`, (select count(*) from alarm al where al.app_id = a.id and al.deleted = 0 and al.status in ('UNHANDLED', 'HANDLING')) as `openAlarmCount`, (select count(*) from alarm al where al.app_id = a.id and al.deleted = 0 and al.status in ('UNHANDLED', 'HANDLING') and al.`level` = 'CRITICAL') as `criticalOpenCount`, (select count(*) from deploy d where d.app_id = a.id and d.deleted = 0 and d.status = 'FAILED') as `failedDeployCount`, (select count(*) from alarm al where al.app_id = a.id and al.deleted = 0 and al.create_time >= (select max(d.finish_time) from deploy d where d.app_id = a.id and d.deleted = 0 and d.status = 'SUCCESS') and al.create_time < date_add((select max(d.finish_time) from deploy d where d.app_id = a.id and d.deleted = 0 and d.status = 'SUCCESS'), interval 24 hour) ) as `alarmAfterSuccess` from app a where a.deleted = 0 order by `openAlarmCount` desc, `criticalOpenCount` desc, `alarmCount` desc, `deployCount` desc limit 8

select a.id as `id`, a.name as `name`, count(*) as `count` from deploy d join app a on d.app_id = a.id and a.deleted = 0 where d.deleted = 0 and d.status = 'FAILED' and d.finish_time >= #{startDate} group by a.id, a.name order by `count` desc

select s.id as `id`, s.hostname as `name`, count(*) as `count` from deploy d join server s on d.server_id = s.id and s.deleted = 0 where d.deleted = 0 and d.status = 'FAILED' and d.finish_time >= #{startDate} group by s.id, s.hostname order by `count` desc

select date_format(finish_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as `date`, count(*) as `total`, sum(case when status = 'FAILED' then 1 else 0 end) as `count` from deploy where deleted = 0 and status in ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED') and finish_time >= #{startDate} group by date_format(finish_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by `date`
select count(*) from deploy_log where deleted = 0 and log_type = 'EXEC' and create_time >= #{startDate} and lower(detail) like concat('%', lower(#{keyword}), '%')
select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as `date`, count(*) as `count` from alarm where deleted = 0 and create_time >= #{startDate} group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by `date`
